concrete_scene.heading: Worked request: SSD shards to closure
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A layer-streaming inference worker serving a quantized checkpoint that exceeds VRAM and host RAM
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Convert the checkpoint into content-addressed shards, prefetch each layer from SSD through pinned host buffers, generate under a frozen request contract, and close all derived state.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The request accounts for transfers, stalls, cache hits, KV growth, speculative work, cleanup, and fallback while checksum, storage, thermal, deadline, cancellation, and residual failures remain typed stop conditions.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether an emitted token or overlapped transfer establishes a successful fast-generation lifecycle; incomplete cleanup, hidden bandwidth, or unverified output prevents that conclusion.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The serving and custody owners retain corrupted shards, scratch files, shared-prefix leases, KV pages, partial outputs, failed cleanup, cache pollution, and recovery obligations.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The worked request is an architecture trace rather than a local AirLLM, FlexGen, or paging benchmark; it establishes no speed, memory, quality, energy, or hardware result.

worked_trace.heading: Worked request: SSD shards to closure
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The request trace specifies an honest paging and closure contract; it does not reproduce a paging system or establish quality-equivalent latency, throughput, memory, energy, or useful-speed improvement.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The smallest fully resident model meeting the task contract is the strongest baseline, followed by unified-memory and ordinary offload paths; streaming must beat them after transfer, verification, recovery, and residual cost.
readable_claim: “The model emitted a token” is therefore an intermediate event, not the end of the memory lifecycle.
normative_rule: A competent comparison begins with the smallest fully resident model that meets the task contract, a CPU or unified-memory path, ordinary CPU/GPU offload, layer streaming, planned placement where available, exact and predictive KV variants, architecture-compatible sparse placement, and a prediction-disabled fallback.

formal_binding.anchor: Fast-generation admission is consumer-, workload-, model-

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked request is explicitly an architecture path and does not convert source-reported paging feasibility into a local result.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Model, workload, hardware, quality, verifier, cache, memory, bandwidth, energy, recovery, and deployment limits remain in the qualification and evidence sections.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The prose trace retains only lifecycle-changing measurements; large metric matrices and source comparisons remain in qualification and evidence surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The emitted-token reader claim gives a short entry into the comprehensive admission contract.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The local no-benchmark boundary remains once while distinct failure and qualification limits stay actionable.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The request is prose-led; metric inventories remain reference material.

non_claims: The trace does not reproduce AirLLM, FlexGen, or any paging implementation.
The trace does not establish useful speed, quality, memory, energy, or deployment gains.
The editorial packet does not move support or release state.
